name: Surf for Lucky Blocks
desc:
Welcome to Surf for Lucky Blocks! 🌊🏄‍♂️

Ride the waves and collect Lucky Blocks! ✨
Don’t fall into the water! 🌊😱
Bring Lucky Blocks back to your Base to earn Money! 💰
Upgrade your speed and surfboard to go even further! 🏄‍♂️⚡

Can you find the rarest Lucky Blocks? 👀🌈
